title: Share request with others
privacyHint: Only selected guardians can see your request and the {careTerm}'s reply.
protected: This request stays private. The {careTerm} has enabled family protection.
noRecipients: There are no other guardians with access to the parents app.
optionsHint: You can still send the request and share it later.
buttonTooltip: Opens a window where you choose who sees the request.
saveTooltip: Saves who may see the request and the reply.
closeTooltip: Closes the window; the selection stays unchanged.
